activeEvents.companyMarket: Amazon / AWS / AMZN / AI infrastructure / Nasdaq
activeEvents.headline: Amazon AWS revenue rises 39% to $46B but trailing free cash flow turns negative $42.4B as AI capex reaches $220B planned for 2026; shares fall after hours
activeEvents.scope: Amazon / hyperscaler AI capex / cloud demand / Nasdaq
activeEvents.whyItMatters: AWS accelerated sharply and AWS operating income rose to $17.8B, supporting AI-compute demand, but $42.4B trailing-12-month negative free cash flow and a 2026 cash capex plan of approximately $220B intensify concerns about hyperscaler AI investment returns. Q4 sales guidance of $240B-$247B had a midpoint slightly below market consensus. Strong AWS growth is not proof of incremental orders for individual chip suppliers.

activeEvents.companyMarket: Sandisk / SNDK / NAND / AI data-center storage / SOX
activeEvents.headline: Sandisk fiscal Q1 revenue jumps to $11.03B, data-center revenue rises 61% sequentially to $4.80B; guides Q2 to $12.2B-$12.6B and announces 8-for-1 split
activeEvents.scope: NAND memory / AI storage / semiconductor supply chain
activeEvents.whyItMatters: AI-driven NAND and data-center storage demand accelerated: Sandisk data-center revenue was $4.802B versus $2.977B in the preceding quarter and $269M a year earlier. Q2 guidance and $5B completed quarterly buybacks indicate strong profitability and capital returns. The eight-for-one stock split is mechanical and does not itself create shareholder value. High storage pricing may simultaneously pressure PC OEM demand.

activeEvents.companyMarket: Intel / INTC / SOX / AI server CPUs / semiconductor manufacturing
activeEvents.headline: Intel forecasts Q4 revenue $15B-$16B below consensus amid PC weakness and Israel fab disruption; INTC plunges after hours despite 78% data-center AI growth
activeEvents.scope: Intel / SOX / PC supply chain / AI server CPUs / foundry
activeEvents.whyItMatters: Intel's Q3 revenue rose 21% to $16.5B and Data Center and AI segment revenue rose 78% to $7.3B, but Q4 guidance of $15B-$16B was materially below analyst estimates around $17B. Intel said high memory prices weigh on PC demand and a fatal explosion at its Kiryat Gat fab forced a roughly two-week shutdown, expected to reduce revenue by about $600M over two quarters. The disruption and weaker PC demand may spill over to sector sentiment without implying equivalent AI GPU demand weakness.
